plate_comment: Sets the commanded throttle (e2m 1047 Commanded_Throttle, 0-400 = 0-100 %). The calculated commanded throttle comes from cm848_calculateCommandedThrottleFromPedal, from accelerator_pedal_dual_channel_validated_demand with the dual channel pedal, or from channel 13 while its held value (the J1939 pedal) is enabled - that case sets the commanded throttle straight from channel 13 and returns when j1939_input_source_priority is below the channel's held value source priority. While a claimer holds alternate_throttle_priority the commanded throttle is the alternate throttle (selected_alternate_throttle_priority keeps the priority; the claim is cleared every pass); then the per-pass change commanded_throttle_delta and its first order filter (was cm848_fuelDemandFinalCalculation)

Calculated_Commanded_Throttle (e2m 1047 +10) from the analog pedal: (accelerator_pedal_sensor_counts - the autozero) x 400 / accelerator_pedal_throttle_range (e2m 1048 Throttle_Range), at most 400; 0 while a pedal fault holds (registered fault bits 10 / 11 set the low word of throttle_fuel_enable_flag, or detected fault bits 63 / 68) or the pedal is at or below the autozero. The autozero is accelerator_pedal_autozero_cal, or accelerator_pedal_test_cell_autozero with the test cell override, which also sets accelerator_off_idle (was cm848_fuelDemandBaseCalculation)

The throttle validation pass (analog pedal: no held value, no dual channel). Idle validation (cm848_evaluateIdleValidationSwitches, cm848_updateOffIdleFromIdleValidation); then, with no pedal fault, the transition state (cm848_updateThrottleTransitionState) and the Throttle_Min learning (cm848_learnAcceleratorPedalAutozero), else Throttle_Min = accelerator_pedal_highest_valid_minimum + 4; then cm848_monitorAcceleratorPedalIdleValidationFaults. Fault bit 197 also sets the pedal fault flag. With the test cell throttle switch override it only clears fault bits 62 / 63 / 68 when they are registered (was cm848_fuelDemandCoordinator)

The throttle transition state (e2m 1047 +6 Transition_State, 'state of potentiometer and idle validation switch readings'): 0 -> 1 and 2 -> 3 once the idle switch is on, the off-idle switch off and the pedal at or below Throttle_Min + accelerator_pedal_autozero_offset; 1 -> 2 when idle validation state 1 holds and the pedal is above Throttle_Min + accelerator_pedal_above_idle_transition_range (e2m 1048 Throttle_Transition_Range). cm848_monitorAcceleratorPedalIdleValidationFaults acts in state 3. No rate limiter (was cm848_fuelDemandRateLimiterStateMachine)

Boot initialization of the commanded throttle record: the confidence counter, idle validation state, transition state and off-idle flag to 0, Throttle_Min = accelerator_pedal_highest_valid_minimum + 4, the previous commanded throttle (high word of throttle_fuel_enable_flag) to 0, and the delta filter (accumulator 0, coefficient commanded_throttle_delta_filter_coefficient) (was cm848_initFuelDemandRateVariables)

The remote throttle hand-over latch (algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal.remote_throttle_transition_verification_enable): with the remote throttle switch on (switch 31, switch_input_state_bits.unwired_switch in this build) and the remote pedal sound, sets remote_throttle_transition_verified_flag once remote_accelerator_pedal_sensor_filtered is at or below the calculated commanded throttle; with the switch off or a remote pedal fault (fault bit 78; with channel 8's held value enabled, a J1939 pedal timeout or fault bit 129) it clears it once the calculated commanded throttle is at or below the remote pedal. So the hand-over between the pedals never jumps (was fuel_demandRateLimit_outputCheck)

Boot initialization of the remote throttle (cm848_applicationMain): clears remote_throttle_transition_verified_flag and, with algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal.remote_throttle_enable off, the remote throttle fault bits 171 / 172 (detected and registered). It clears no engine protection fault (was cm848_clearEngineProtectionFaultsConditional)

Searches obd_dtc_code_table (170 fault slots) for the 2-byte OBD DTC code and returns 1 with its slot index, or 0 (also for code 0). The table holds P-codes (0x0606 = P0606), not SPNs (was cm848_lookupFaultSpnIndex) | earlier note: searches the SPN table obd_dtc_code_table for a matching SPN and returns its table index

SCI diagnostic link next-byte callback of command 52 (cm848_sciCommand52ReportFaultStatusByDtc): collects the 2-byte DTC code, finds its fault slot with cm848_lookupFaultIndexByDtcCode and reports that slot's status (was cm848_sciCommand52ReportFaultStatusBySpnCallback) | earlier note: SCI diagnostic link next-byte callback: command 52 SPN -> fault status | review-function-readability reviewed 2026-11-12 - Readability Low Accuracy Confidence Medium
